entries.name: Fallen Knight
entries.description: Once sworn to the Dominion of the Preliator. The oath broke; the training did not. Hardens when wounded.

entries.name: Occultist
entries.description: A reader of the Eye hidden in the Dominion's own letters. Draws breath from every death they cause.

entries.name: Assassin
entries.description: A shade of the tithe-alleys. Strikes against the unaware land true and land hard.
